prepare_binary_text_classification: create a TextBinaryClassificationPreprocessor to split, normalize columns, and push binary text classification data to Hugging Face Hub
prepare_llm_training_data: build an LLMPreprocessor to normalize prompt and rejected text columns then push LLM training data to the hub
prepare_token_classification: use TextTokenClassificationPreprocessor to parse token lists, assign class labels, and save token classification datasets locally or to the hub
prepare_seq2seq_data: create a Seq2SeqPreprocessor to split sequence-to-sequence training data into train and validation sets and push to the hub
prepare_extractive_qa: build a TextExtractiveQuestionAnsweringPreprocessor to normalize question, answer, and context columns then save extractive QA datasets
